correctness.rationale: Explicit eight-perfect-matching classification; the 15-facet nerve has contractible cover intersections; every one of 18 elementary free-face collapses is checked and leaves a connected 8-vertex 13-edge graph. This proves an integral wedge of six circles. Independent acyclic Morse matching confirms it. Twelve graph automorphisms and full signed chain Lefschetz traces agree between the original and nerve complexes, giving the asserted character.

value.rationale: This is an exact homotopy classification for the Tietze graph, the canonical 12-vertex non-Hamiltonian cubic triangle expansion of Petersen, and the first natural small case comparing perfect-matching extendibility topology under that expansion. It supplies a new graph-specific intrinsic integral wedge invariant and complete rational automorphism character with vanishing invariants, with a concise structural 18-collapse nerve proof; significance does not depend on a claimed general theorem.
